name: agent-pager
description: Pages your phone (ntfy or Telegram) when the coding agent finishes a long turn or needs you, and lets you reply from the phone.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Where pages go: ntfy (no signup), telegram (your own bot), or off.

ntfy_topic.title: ntfy topic
ntfy_topic.description: Topic name to publish to. Anyone who knows it can read it, so pick something long and random.

ntfy_server.title: ntfy server
ntfy_server.description: ntfy server URL. Leave as is for the public server, or point it at your own.

ntfy_token.title: ntfy access token
ntfy_token.description: Optional access token for a protected topic or a self-hosted server.

ntfy_inbound.title: Accept prompts over ntfy
ntfy_inbound.description: Treat messages you publish to the topic as prompts. Off by default: ntfy has no sender check, so anyone with the topic name could send prompts.

telegram_token.title: Telegram bot token
telegram_token.description: The token BotFather gave you for your bot.

telegram_chat_id.title: Telegram chat id
telegram_chat_id.description: Your chat id with the bot. Messages from any other chat are ignored.

inbound.title: Reply from the phone
inbound.description: Poll the backend for your messages and queue them as prompts. One session at a time holds the poller.

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to check for messages from the phone.

min_turn_seconds.title: Page after a turn longer than (seconds)
min_turn_seconds.description: A finished turn pages you only when it ran at least this long. 0 pages every turn.

ask_delay_seconds.title: Question delay (seconds)
ask_delay_seconds.description: Wait this long before paging about an open question, so answering at the keyboard stays quiet.

min_gap_seconds.title: Minimum gap between pages (seconds)
min_gap_seconds.description: Automatic pages closer together than this are dropped.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: Local time range with no automatic pages, like 22-07 or 22:30-06:45. Empty means none.

private_mode.title: Private mode
private_mode.description: Send only that the agent needs you, with no project name, reply text or question.

notify_errors.title: Page on errors
notify_errors.description: Page when a turn ends on an API error.
